provenance: Every fixture in this corpus was authored fresh for Rúnmál by the campaign keeper on 2026-10-30. No third-party user content was copied, downloaded, or scraped: the shapes follow the mirrors' public file-format specifications and public documentation only (clean-room law), and all names, text, and worlds are original to this corpus. Fixtures are therefore under the repository's own licence and may be redistributed with it.
purpose: Real-world-shaped character cards, lorebooks, presets, a chat file, and a persona file, used as test fixtures so users' content can be proven to survive import/export trips through Rúnmál's current code — and so the losses that remain are pinned exactly, with their roadmap homes named, instead of discovered by users.
